summary: Now occupying the Zabzimek Corridor inside Gorgas following the 58th Combined Arms Army cross-border operation. IADS active. EW jamming coalition communications along the border. Continues IO and cyber pressure on Gorgas and other regional states.

Western-leaning constitutional republic on the north shore of the Black Sea. Western-majority population seeks NATO and EU membership; eastern minority blocks reforms and aligns with Donovia. Donovia claims portions of eastern Pirtuni and backs separatist activity. The map shades Pirtuni in the Donovian claim envelope — Pirtuni is not Donovian, but it is under sustained Donovian pressure.

The reason CJTF-CAU exists. Contributing 24 F-16C/D fighters and a small modern force to the coalition. The JFLCC (Joint Force Land Component Commander) is Maj Gen Aram Petrosyan, Gorgan Army. Zabzimek Corridor is currently occupied by Donovian forces.
Hosts the Coalition AOC at Atropian Air Base, 220 km south of the Gorgas-Donovia border. Contributing 12 Su-30SM fighters.
Donovian-language separatist enclave inside Gorgas, now seized by Donovian 58th Combined Arms Army. The principal objective for the coalition air campaign.

fullName: France, UK, Poland, UAE, plus contributing nations
summary: Additional partner nations contributing air assets to CJTF-CAU. France deploying 6 Rafales to Atropian Air Base. UK, Poland, UAE also contributing fighter and support aircraft.

fullName: USS Gerald R. Ford Carrier Strike Group · JFMCC
summary: On station in the Caspian Sea with 24 F/A-18E/F Super Hornets. JFMCC: Rear Adm James Kowalski, USN. NALE coordinates carrier air wing integration with the AOC.
